owner_summaries.key_concerns: High exception counts in AP, AR, and flux analysis indicate operational inefficiencies and potential compliance risks.
Bank duplicate detection exceptions require monitoring to ensure timely resolution.

residual_risks.description: Entity-level trial balance not balanced in USD, leading to potential misstatements in consolidated financials.
residual_risks.mitigation_recommendations: Implement automated checks to ensure entity-level trial balances are zeroed out before consolidation.

residual_risks.description: High flux analysis exceptions across accounts indicate potential misclassification or unusual transactions.
residual_risks.mitigation_recommendations: Enhance flux analysis thresholds and provide additional training to staff on exception handling.

residual_risks.description: Intercompany mismatches and accruals exceptions may lead to regulatory scrutiny or audit findings.
residual_risks.mitigation_recommendations: Strengthen intercompany reconciliation processes and implement stricter accruals review protocols.
